**xios-x11** runs X11 apps on the iPad through rootless Xwayland, inside the iosc desktop. Start the iosc desktop from the X11 app and Xwayland comes up with it; X11 apps you open there get the right DISPLAY on their own, and each X window shows up as a normal window on the desktop.

Use it for software that predates Wayland. The old software-rendered Xios X server is retired, so this is the only interactive X11 path.

Xvfb and TigerVNC are still separate packages if you want a headless or remote X display.

Requires iOS 16.5+.

## 0.1.12  ·  2026-10-25
- Requires iosc 0.9.51, where X windows actually appear on screen and a second desktop slot gets its own X display

## 0.1.11  ·  2026-10-25
- Xwayland now actually starts with the iosc desktop, so X11 apps run
- Pulls in the fixed xios-core (the in-app picker works on a clean install)

## 0.1.0  ·  2026-07-01
- First release: Xios X server + Xwayland
